design_coverage.reason: Tables 3–5 use two-dimensional firm and year clustering; no additional cluster data beyond firm/year identifiers are stated.

The source names multiple regressions and logistic regression, but does not fully specify the underlying estimator/link for every baseline model; the AAER printed equation conflicts with the logit prose.
Source includes industry dummies; Table 3 and RAM models identify two-digit SIC industry structure. Industry coding is derived from the annual Compustat historical SIC field.
GVKEY/CRSP link fields are available locally; the source’s KLD/Compustat and CRSP linkage conventions are not fully described.
All continuous variables are winsorized at the top and bottom 1 percent; variable exclusions are not separately stated in this passage.
Paper states 1991–2009 KLD/Compustat sample, excludes SIC 6000–6999, and reports the complete-data N; exact joins and missing-data filters are not executable from the source.
No estimation weights are reported for the frozen baseline regressions.

implementation_issues.description: The paper does not state the aggregation formula for two-digit-SIC industry-year advertising intensity (AD_IND_INT), although it names the input and industry-year level.
The article describes the baseline fit as a multiple regression but does not name the underlying estimator. The supporting accrual and RAM regressions are also not assigned an explicit estimator.

The supporting discretionary-accrual fit leaves its total-accrual component calculation, estimator and exact fitting cells incomplete; it adds lagged ROA but does not give a complete grouping/sample rule.
FIRM_AGE requires CRSP first-appearance dates linked to the Compustat firm, but the source does not state the monthly/daily CRSP choice or valid-link conventions.
